newsitem.title: SPAIN: RALLYING-LIATTI LEADS AFTER LAST STAGE BURST.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-LIATTI LEADS AFTER LAST STAGE BURST.

text.p: Italian Piero Liatti grabbed the outright lead in Spain's Catalunya Rally with a sizzling time on the last stage of Monday's opening day.
Liatti edged ahead of Belgian Bruno Thiry in a Ford and Subaru team mate Colin McRae of Britain in muddy, slippery conditions that invited a mistake.
"It was an attack, but not a big attack," said Liatti.
Thiry dropped three seconds behind after making the wrong tyre choice on the last two stages.
Fellow Belgian Freddie Loix, in a Toyota, took third place from McRae on the closing section.
World champion Tommi Makinen of Finland improved to fifth after adjusting his Mitsubishi's suspension.
Spain's Oriel Gomez stunned the four-wheel drive world championship regulars by filling sixth place in his two-wheel drive Renault.
Crews face extremely fast stages near Tarragona on Tuesday before the closing round of the world championship ends on Wednesday afternoon.
